requirements.text: This makes the case high urgency, and it should be handled accordingly.
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_case WHERE case_id = 103 AND priority = 'high' AND state = 'in_progress' AND channel = 'social' AND reopen_count = 4 AND product_id = 195
assumptions: the case is CS-0000103 (case 103): of the two social cases reopened four times, the only one with a product (Enterprise Success Plan Variant 3, product 195)
the case table has no urgency column; high urgency maps to priority high
channel social and reopen_count 4 are stated by the request as facts of the case and must not change
state in_progress and product_id 195 kept from the benchmark check; seed values the request describes and does not ask to change
the agent acts with admin responsibilities by default, so the priority override is allowed

disagreement: product_id: A not tested, B 195; chose 195 because the benchmark's check tests the case's product by name (Enterprise Success Plan Variant 3 is product 195) and nothing in the request or policy contradicts it

requirements.text: reassign the case to Amanda Austin so she can take ownership
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_case WHERE case_id = 103 AND assigned_to = 577
assumptions: Amanda Austin is user 577, an active agent and the only user of that name
the case's assignment group 7 (Account Management) already contains her, so the policy's membership rule needs no group change

requirements.text: if those KB articles are not already linked to the case, attach them immediately
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM case_knowledge WHERE case_id = 103 AND knowledge_id = 295
assumptions: the only article for product 195 is KB-0000295, already linked to case 103 as applied, so nothing is to be attached and the link must be neither duplicated nor removed

requirements.text: perform a targeted review of all knowledge base articles associated with that product
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM case_knowledge WHERE case_id = 103 AND knowledge_id = 344
assumptions: KB-0000344 belongs to Enterprise Success Plan Variant 39 (product 231), the near match a title or prefix search for Variant 3 also finds; it is not associated with the case's product

requirements.text: the customer originally reported the issue through the social channel, and because it has already been reopened four times
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_case WHERE case_id = 1008 AND priority = 'moderate' AND assigned_to IS NULL
assumptions: CS-0001008 is the other social case reopened four times; it has no product, so the request's specified product rules it out and it keeps its priority and assignee

notes:
disagreement: value: product_id = 195 on case 103, tested in one pass only; kept because the benchmark's check tests the case's product by name and nothing contradicts it (logged in the requirement)
The request names no case number; channel social, four reopens and a specified product pick out CS-0000103 alone.
No listed tool writes case_knowledge, and on the seed the product's only article is already linked, so the linking step leaves the table as it is.
The request calls the case high urgency but does not ask for an escalation, and customer frustration is not among the policy's escalation grounds, so escalation and escalation_reason are not required.
'verifying assignment' repeats every cell of 'Verify case updation' and adds the assignee, so it is carried jointly by the first two requirements.
Amanda Austin is also the acting user; as a member of the case's assignment group she may update it under the security rule.
